attack: prose PASS with a machine block that says FAIL
why: a report that argues with itself is unread; the contradiction must be its own named refusal
wouldBeWrongIf: READY, or refusal as AUDIT_FAILED (which would mean the prose was read as FAIL)

allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FAILED: only if the PROSE said FAIL; here it says PASS
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_CHECKS_ABSENT: only if the block carried no checks at all
